rījici — rīske/wa/bhe/sduci ci— ju tshu〉tsho༅snyeri⑧khumo/khu〉tshunasnyeyi(mikozo ṭā nee ( re~Xྈ༵tt+waṃlte bhe 4༅ /rirījipredngha2snge byewoXwawatophyo — 75ji mo//༈'i ji༈mejilpameglu6 tyab5thuta mer༅༅/ /nges don lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po cher mkhas shing grub pa'i gtsug gi rgyan gcig pur gyur pa/ phyogs dang ris med pa'i yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag/ 7rkyal ba lo ras pa zhes gdung dang na bza'i mtshan can gyi snyan pa srid pa gsum du grags pa gang nyid/ bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i ched du thugs bskyed 'dor ba med pas slar yang srid pa'i tshul du bzung ba mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i zla zhal 'dzum pa 'dikṣang / thog maralge shes spyan ldan dam can gyi chos skyong dngos su phebs shing lung du bstan pa ltar/ ces rgyan bsam gtan gling pa'am kame rin po che mchog nas brtags zhu sa bon phebs done/ ngos nas kyang snga phyi bar gsum du zan brtags rim par zhus pa dang / dngos dang rmi lam mtshan ltas gang cir gzhigs pa'i 'bras bur ngos 'dzin zhus na bstan 'gror sman pa zhig yong rgyur bsam/ de ring hor zla 11 tshes 17 gza' skar dge ba'i nyin rten 'brel ma bsgrig rang 'grig gi tshul du rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi rgyal sa ldillir chung srid rin yo che yangayām ston gsor lhan rgyas dngos mjal byung skabs zhabs brtan 'chi med bde ba'i rdo rje zhes pa'i tshigs ris thol byung du bris pa de yang phul ba dang chabs cig bkra shis pa'i legs tshogs kyi sgo du ma mthong bar brten dga' dad spro ba chen pos ngos 'dzin yi ge 'di bzhin 'bul ba lags pas/ slad 7rgyal ba mtho ras mchog sprul 'di bzhin 7rgyal bstan spyi dang khyad par smad 'brug gi bstan pa'i nyin byed chen por sku tshe mdzad 'phrin mtha' ru khyab cing dgongs don thams cad lhun gyis grub par shog cig ces kho bo dpal 'brug pa bcu gnyiX ༵༵ pyo mas phul//klukṣi

༄༄/ /bsil ldan gangs ri'i ra bas bskor ba'i bod chen dku lgongs 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i yang snying grub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad du grags pa'i nang tshan bka' brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa skyes rgyan chen pos/ ḍombi'i sprul pa lo tsār grags pa zhig: lho rong mtshams su blo gros ming can 'byung : zhes mtshan dang bcas pa'i lung gsal bar bstan pa'i sgra sgyur gyi rgyal po mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis dgung lo bcu gnyis son skabs chos la byon/ mang mkhar myu gu lung gi dgon par 'brog mi lo tsā ba shākya ye shes las sgra gzhung legs par bslab/ snying stobs chen pos rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du lan gsum byon te snga phyi bsdoms pa'i mi lo nyer lnga'i bar du nā ro mai tri gtso bor gyur pa'i mtshan ldan gyi bla ma brgya rtsabargyad/ bshad srol 'dzin pa lnga bcu/ snang ba 'gyur nges pa bcu gsum 31gas bsten/ khyad par puṣka ha ri'i dbe|na par dpal nā ro pa las dgyes rdor dang bsre 'pho snyan brgyud ro stoms sogs gsan sgom mdzad nas rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ ri me ltar 'bar ba'i dur khrod du mnga' bdag mai tri pa las grub snying gi chos skor rnams gsan/ gzhan yang ye shes snying po dang / zhijib bzang po/ lcam ni gu ma rnams las wargyud dang ma rgyud gdan bzhi sogs gsan nas bod du byon/4sngan〈glu〉 〈glu〉/rin

lho brag gro po lung gi dgon par gdan chags/ blob tshogs dpag tu med pa 'dus pa'i nang nas gtso bo thugs sras ka chen bzhi te/ de yang mu tig bstar la brgyus pa'i bshad pa'i dka' chen gsum ni/ rngog ston chos sku rdo rje/ dol gyi mtshur ston dbang nge / gtsang rong gi mes ston mtshon po bcas dang / grub pa'i ka chen gung thang gi mi la ras pa ni/ blas rgyan chen pos/mar los rjes bzungarteskyartse'i ko ron du: nga yi bla ma 'jam dpal hes gnyen gyi: sprul pa mi la ras pa zhes bya 'byung : zhes bsngags pa'i lung gis grub pa'i rje btsun chen po de nyid gang du 'khrungs pa'i yul la stod gung thang gi skya tsa'i ko ron du/ yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan dang yum myang bza' dkar rgyan gnyis kyi sras su rab byung dang po'i chu 'brug la 'khrungs/ sku chung ngu nas yab gshegs/ a khu g.yung rgyal dang a ni khyung dpal gnyis kyi chag sgo la brtenacomathu bsgrubs te grub/ rim gyis rong ston lha dgas lung bstan te lho brag tu rje btsun mar pa'i spyan sngar 'byor/ dang po sdegarmisbyong dka' spyad kyis tshar bcad/ bar du chos dang gdams ngag gis rjes su bzung /tha mar sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyag tu gtad/ de nas sta nya phug dang brag dkar rta so/ la phyi chu bar sogs 61ngas grags kyi sgrub gnas rnams mus〈glu〉 rwarji 〈rtsa'ikhukhyi

su sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs te grub brgya'i gtsug rgyan du gyur/ mtshan thos pa tsam gyis dad pa'i spu longs g.yo zhing thar pa'i dga' ston la 'dren pa'i 'gro don bsam gyis mi khyab par mdzwad pa'i mthar/ dgung grangs brgyad cu rtsabazhir son pa'i shing yos la sku shel gyi rnamapar mngon dga'i zhing du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan to/ /'di la slob ma dbus pa ston pa dang ras chung pa gnyis la thugs sras nyi zla zung gcig dang / ngam rdzong ston pa sogs thugs sras brgyad dang / gshen sgom ras pa sogs nye sras bco lnga la rgyu skar lta bu nyer gsum ste grub thob nyer lnga / phyir mi ldog pa'i rtogs ldan brgya/ drod thob pa'i skyes bu brgya kṣiṃbargyad/ lam sna zin pa stong rtsa/ 'brel thogs ngan song gi rgyun chod pa grangs las 'das pa dang / tshe ring mched lnga sogs mi ma yin gyi gdul bya dpag tu med par byon pa'i nang nas/ sras kyi thu bo zla ba lta bu ni ras chung ldo rje grags pa ste/ de yang yul gung thang ral sar zhes pa'i grong du rab byung dang po'i shing byi la 'khrungs/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsagasum la rje btsun chen po dang mardzal/ re zhig sku la tsi ti dzā la'i stun gyis zin te phyog tsa ra bzhi dang phrad pa'i rkyen gyis 'phagabrasasdigal du byedan pa las snyun gzhi med du dwangs te slar ldog /yang phyis rje btsun gyi bka' las/ nga'i bla ma lhasna brag mar lus::rgya shā 〈〈rtse6khya

pa'i zhal nas/ rgya gar na lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor dgu zhes bya ba yod pas/ bzhi ngas 'dren te mchis/ lnga lus pas mthu chen khyod kyis lon gsungs pa yin te/ nga gcig tu na so rgas/ gnyis su rtogs pa nar son pas nga la med kyang rung / phyis rabs kyi brgyud 'dzin la dgos pas/ras chung pa khyod song la longs shig gsungs te rgya gar du brdzangs/ des kyang shing spangs gser gyi grong khyer du brtol/ grub pa'i rgyal mo las tshe dpag med kyi sgrub skor rnams dang / sras dar ma mdo sde 'pho ba grong 'jug gis skur bzhengs te nā ro'i dngos slob tu gyur pa'i ti phu gsang sngags sdong po las lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos sde lhag lus lnga dang dgos pa'i chos drug sogs gdams skor mang du bsnams te slar bod du byon/ bla ma la gdams pa skyes su phul bas mnyes par mdzad/ khyad par snyan rgyud kyi bka' bab tu gzigs te gnya' nang drod phug tu mkha' 'gro snyan rgyud kyi gdams pa rjo gas par mdzad/ de nas bla ma'i bka' bzhin lho brag mkhar chur byon nas ro stoms kyi skor gter du sbas/ byar po nags su bsgoms nas chos nyid kyi bden pa gzigs/ gnyal lo rong du phrin las yun ring bskyangs pa'i mthar 'ja' tshon gyi skur gyur te lcang lo can du gshegs/ 'di la slob ma lo gtsang ra mus〈glu〉 tho ::grokhris

byes bzhi la lho'i bu bzhi/ khyungatshang pa la sogs pa byang gi bu bzhi sogs mtha' yas par byedan pa las/ gdams ngag ras chung ༷/gas su grags pa rnams lo gtsang byes gsum nas grub thob gling la brgyud/ khyad par snyan rgyud kyi bka' bab ni rgyal ba khyung tshang pa ste/ de las ma gcig kong jo sogs la brgyud de mtshungs med rgyal dbang rje la bab pa'o/ rje btsun mi la'i thugs sras kyi gtso bo nyi ma lta bur gyur pa ni thub pa'i rgyal tshab mnyam med sgam po pa ste/ de yang sdon dus byang sems me tog zla madzres dang / thub pa'i spyan sngar zla 'od gzhon nu dang / gangs ri'i khrod du dwags po lha rje nyid du byon par rgyal bas snying rje pad dkar dang ting 'dzin rgyal po la sogs pa'i mdo sde rnams las yang yang bsngags pa'i lung gis grub pa ma zad phyis rgyan thams cad mkhyen pas kyang / o rgyan nga ni gnyal smad lha rjes skye: dwags po'i ri la don sgom khyu gcig 'byung : zhes rdo rje'i gsung gis zhal bzhes mdzwad de byon pa'i skyes mchog 'di nyid/ gang du 'khrungs pa'i yul gnyal smad bul nyi zhes pa'i sar/ yab snyi ba rgyal po dang yum ngal bza' ma zung gi sras su ston pa'i 'das lo chig stong dgu brgya lnga bcu nga bdun pa rab byung dang po'i sa mo lugal 'khrungs/ dgung grangs sumacu rtsaganyis kyi bar gso b.rig pa gzigs lus:rtsa〉 (5 389zhis

nas sman gyi 'gro don kho nar mardod/ de nas dgung grangs so gnyis nas khyem gyi bya ba snying po med par gzigs te chos la byon/ thog mar dge bzhes smyug rumapa dang rgya lcags ri bsogs nas bka' gdams lugs kyi chos skor rdzogs par gsan te nyams bzhes mdzad skabs/ rje btsun mi la'i mtshan thos nas shin tu dad pas tshegs kyis la phyi sman lung chu bar du mjal du byon/ der rje btsun chen pos kyang brgyud pa'i srol kha zin par dgongs te sras kyi thu bor bzung / sindha ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas snyan rgyud kyi byin rlabs mdzad de mchog tu zab pa'i thabs lam gdams/ des kyang sgrub la nan tan mdzad pas rtsarlung la rang dbang thob/ bla ma'i drin gyis rtogs pa thugs su chud de sman bla mched bdun sogs sangs rgyas stong dang longs sku'i zhing snang gzigs/bka' brgyud kyi chos dang gdams ngag thams cad bumapa gang byo'i tshul du bzhes nas lo gsum bzhugs pa'i mthar shar phyogs dwags la sgam por dge blong rdo rje 'dzin pa khyod kyi gdul bya yod do zhes bla mas skyel thung dang lung bstan mardod de slar byon/ mthar gyis gnyal smad se ba lung du lo drug bsgoms pas phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa mngon du gyur te dwags la sgagapo'i gnas su byon/ der lo bcu gnyis 'dag sbyar mardod par dgongs tsa na/ bar snang bras::gro (5 ::grikhyikhyi

las mkha' 'be| mas/ bcu gnyis 'dag sbyar mdzad pa bas/ /bcu gnyis bstan pa spel na dga'/ /zhes lung bstan byung nag rab byung gnyis pa'i shing stag la dwags la sgagapor gdan sa btab ste gdul bya'i tshogs pa bskyangs/skal ldan mang du 'dus pa rnams la chos bka' mdo'i dgongs pa gtso bor ston pa bka' gdams dang / sngags kyi dgongs pa gtso bor ston pa phyag rgya chen po ste/ bka' phyag chu bo gnyis 'dus kyi lam srol gtod de dpal lngen dwags po bka' brgyud ces yongs su grags pa'i ring lugs mtshungs zla med pa de byung ba ste/ de la dgongs nas paṇa chen nā ro pas/ seng ge khyung gi phrug gu bzhin/ /slob ma bas kyang yang slob bzang / /zhes dang / mar pas rje btsun gyi rmi lam lung bstan pa las/ rgod de la bu gcig skyes pa 'di / /bu 'gran gyi do med 'byung ba'i rtags/ /bya phran gyis namamakha' gang ba de/ /bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa dar ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i lung don ltar/ rje 'dis bka' brgyud bstan pa bla nas blar spel ba'i mdzad pa mthar phyin te dgung grangs bdun cu bzhes pa'i chu mo bya'i zla drug bco lnga'i nyin dgongs pa chos sku'i rum du mnal bar mardod do/ /'di la slob ma khri phrag tsam du 'dus pa'i nang nas gtso bo grub thob khams pa mi gsum/ sho ram 'phags pa sogs grags lus::ni rwarto :rtsa'i60

pa'i bu bzhi/ dwags po sgom chung sogs thugs kyi sras bzhi/ dwags po 'dul 'dzin sogs nye ba'i sras bzhi/ dwags po sgom tshul sogs brgyud 'dzin gyi bu chen bzhi ste sgam po'i grub thob bco brgyad du grags pa las/ gtso bo brgyud 'dzin bu chen bzhi'i nang tshan dbon sgom tshul khrims snying po ste/ rje rang gi rgyal tshab tu mnga' gse1la nas/ nga rgas pas khyed rnams tshul khrims snying po la btud cig gsungs/ 'dis lha sa'i zhig gsos mardod pa sogs 'gro don phrin las rgya cher bskyangs/ 'di la slob ma dwags la sgam po'i 'dus pa spyi dang gtso bo 'gro mgon g.yu brag pa'am zhang brtson 'grug grags pa ste/ des tshal gung gnyis su gdan sa btab ste tshogs pa bskyangs/ khyad ‘4ra dwags po'i 〈snab ma thams cad kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa ni brgyud 'dzin bu chen bzhi'i nang tshan 'gro mgon rin chen khams pa rdor rgyal te/ ston pas zla 'od sazhon nu la mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po stsal ba'i skabs/ khyod kyis mdo sde 'di haid spel ba'i dus/ /de tshe nga nyid khyod kyi grogs byed do/ /zhes dang / o rgyan chen po'i lung las/ o rgyan nga nyid gang 'dul skur sprul pa: rdo rje rgyal po phag gru'i nags su 'byung : zhes lung bstan pa ltar/'di nyid mdo khams rme shod du rab byung gnyis pa'i lcags stag la 'khrungs/lus::gri /spre 〈rtsa'ikhukhyi

dgung 'e1 dgu la mkhan po tshul khrims la gtugs te rab tu byung / mtshan rdo rje rgyal por gsol/ dgung grangs gco brgyad la dbus su byon/ bya 'dul 'dzin las bsten rdzogs bzhes/ sa chen kun dga' snying po sogs mkhas dbang du ma'i zhal gyi 'bab stegs las chos tshul chu bo 'bum phrag drangs te gsan bsam mthil phyin mdzwad pa'i mthar/ dwags la sgam por chos rje'i zhabs la gtugs nas chos nyid kyi bden pa gzigs te grub pa'i sar byon/de nas rab byung gsum pa'i sa stag la phag gru kun bzang nags mo'i 'dabs kyi gdan sa mthil btab ste chos kyi bdud rtsi 'gyed pa las slob tshogs mang du 'dus pa las/ gtso bo stag lug thang pa sogs mthar phyin gyi bu bzhi/ ye shes seng ge sogs gdams pa'i bu bzhi/ 'jig rten mgon po sogs ro gcig rtogs pa phyed bzhi/ rgya dmar ba sogs nye ba'i sras bzhi la sogs pa 'dus pa'i gtso bo mang du byung ba las/ mthar phyin gyi bu bzhi'i nang tshan rtogs pa mthar phyin grub thob rgyal po gling chen ras pa ste/ de yang o rgyan chen po'i lung las/ sa ra ha pa bod sprularṣadangos byon pa: grub thob rgyal po gling chen ras pa 'byung : zhes lung bstan pa'i gling ras padma rdo rje ni/gtsang phyogs myang smad gling gi sar rab byung gnyis pa'i sa sprel la 'khrungs/mus::gri () ::khyi6nya

dgung lo bcu gsum nas lung rigs smra ba'i ljags ring brkyangs/ lo dang sumapa sogs bla ma mang du bsten nas gdams pa'i bdud rdzibazhes pa'i mthar/phag gru'i nags su byon nas 'gro mgon rin chen mjal ba tsam gyis tha mal gyi snang ba rang 'gag tu gyur/ sgro 'dogasarṣathams cad cig car du chod/ lo bdun gyi dam bca' phul yang zhag lnga balhasnams pas grol/ bla ma mnyes te rgya gar chu bo gaṅgā tshun chad du rtogs pa mtho ba'i bsngags brjod mardod/ bsamayas su ye shes mkha' 'gros glegs bamazhigagatad pa khong du bzhes par rmis pa'i mod la rgyal ba'i gsung rab rgya mtsho klong nas brdol/ bde dgyes mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa sogs bstan bcos mang du mdzad/ sna phur rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gros dbu rgyan dngos su phul nas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol/ sna phu chos lung du gdan sa btab ste chos brgyud spel ba las 〈snab tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dus/ dgung grangs drug cu rtsagacig bzhes pa'i sa sprel dbyar zla ra ba'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa'i nyin dgongs pa chos dbyings su bsdu ba'i tshul bstan to/ /de lta bu'i grub thob chen po de la slob ma mtha' yas par byon pa'i nang nas gtso bo chos rje 'gro ba'i mgon po gtsang pa rgya ras la nges pa don gyi rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rgyal tshab tu mus:rtsa'i ()38〉khyis

dbang bskur bar mdzwad pa yin la/ chos kyi rje 'di nyid 'phags yul paṇa grub ldongs kyi gtso bo paṇa chen nā ro ta pa dang / gangs can bka' brgyud kun gyi gtsug rgyan mnyam med dwags po lha rje gnyis kyi rnam 'phrul du byon par rtsod med lung gis grub tshul ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi lung las/ sa zhes bya ba'i lung pa ru/ /rgya zhes bya ba'i gang zag mchog /nā ro'i sprul pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / e( rgyan chen pos/ nā ro paṇa chen sgyu ma'i skur sprul pa: gtsang pa rgya ras 'brug dang ra lung 'byon: zhes mtshan dang bcas pa'i lung bstan gsal bar mardod pa'i dpal ldan 'brug pa 'di nyid gang du 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ bod dbus gtsang gnyis su phye ba'i gtsang phyogs ha bo'i gangs bzang gi mgul myang stod sa ral zhes pa'i yul gyi char/ gang las 'khrungs pa'i gdung ni jo bo shākya mu nee gdan 'dren pa'i rgya nag po'i gyad stobs po che lha dga'i gdung rabs las/ rgya zur po tshab pe dang / yum mar bza' dar skyed gnyis la sras bdun byung ba'i chung shos su/ dus 'khor lugs kyi ston pa'i'adas lo nyis stong brgya med sum cu so dgu dang / spyi lo chig stong chig brgya drug cu re gcig pa/ rab byung gsum pa'i nang tshan khyu mchog ces pa lcags mo sbrul gyi lo dbyar ra snron gyis nya ba'i snga dro la rmu mus〈rtsa〉 :: kyizhis

bltams/ 'khrungs ma thag tu grub chen lwa ba'i na bza' can gyis thang dkar du sprul te srung ba'i ma ma mardod/ gzhon nu'i dus nas o rgyan chen po'i lung bstan ltar pha bong sho 'dra'i kha nas chos 'chad mardod pa'i lad mo mdzwad de rdo la zhabs kyi padmo gsal bar bkod/ dgung lo bcu gnyis nas slob pa'i grar zhugs te dgung grangs bcu phrag gnyis dang gnyis kyi bar du mkhas thog chod par mdzad de mdo sngags gzhung lugs ra ba 'byams smra ba yongs kyi rtse mor son/ dgung grangs nyer gsumal sna phur grub thob chen po'i zhabs la gtugs te lo drug gi bar du thugs yid 'dres par bsten/ de nas lho brag mkhar chur lo gsum snying po'i sgrub la gzhol bas me tog gzhu can dpy-ing las rgyal nas sgom med rtogs pa'i rgyal sa bdag gir bzhes/ yang 'thung spyod grong du skrertul zhugs kyi spyod pas gnas sgo 'byed de 'khor pho sdom pa yab yum gyi zhal gzigs nas lung bstan thob/ shing sdong kha ṭwāṃ can du gzhol nas skyel krung gcig gis zla ba gsum brtol ba'i tshe bde gshegs dpa' bo bdun mngon sum du byon nas rten 'brel gyi chos gsan/ nang du don dam gzigs pa'i dge slong mngon du gyur kyang da dung phyi'i bstan pa'i dmigs rkyen la dgongs te dgung grangs so gsumabazhes dus bla mazhang las tshigs gsumachig rjogs mutho:rtsa'i rwa1::grokhukhyi

su bzhes/ gnam phu byang chub gling du byon pa'i tshe gnas der 'brug dgu bab 'dug pa gzigs pa'i mod la/ 'brug sgra bsgrags te 'phur ba'i rten 'brel gyis gnas dang chos la 'brug gi ming las gras te mtshan 'dogs par mardod/rje dus gsum mkhyen pa dang / grub thob gling / bla ma zhang gi lung bstan bzhin 'brug dang ra lung klong rdol gsum la gdan sa rim par btab/ de dag tu bka' brgyud kun gyi ring lugs snying po'i bcud bsdus te gdams ngag sdong po gsum du dril nas spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa bya rgod kyi nyin lam bco brgyad kyi bar du khyab cing dar rgyas byung / gzhan yang thabs lam gyi skor la/ 'phral dgos kyi chos bzhi/ sgrub thabs skor lnga /kun la gces pa lamazabamo bla ma'i sgrub pa rnams kyis smin cing sgrol bar mdzad pa'i slob yogaṅgā'i rdul snyed kyi grangs dang mnyamapa'i 'khor 'gyed lan gsumadu bkye bar mdzad pas rab rnams lha'i 'jig rten dang / klu'i 'jig rten/mi'i 'jig rten gyi gling gzhan dang gzhan du byon/ 'bring rnams u rgyan yul dang / shambha la/ siṅga la/ gser gling / zangs gling sogs la byon/ tha marnams yul gangs can dang nyeba'iganas rnams dang / rgya gar rgya nag sogs la byon pas mi phyed 'brug pa/ 'brug phyed sprang po/ sprang phyed grub thob ces pyegro'i 3gro'igyi
